raw.catalogue_text: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Children of Parents Engaged in Unclean and Hazardous Occupations | Provider: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment | Academic Year: 2026-27 | Type: Special Social Vulnerability | Open: 2026-06-01 | Close: 2026-10-31
raw.specification_text:
Scheme Name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Children of Parents Engaged in Unclean and Hazardous Occupations
Ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
Department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
Target Classes: Class 1, Class 2, Class 3, Class 4, Class 5, Class 6, Class 7, Class 8, Class 9, Class 10
Academic Requirement: Enrolled in a recognized institution in Classes 1 through 10.
School Type Requirement: 
Annual Income Ceiling: Rs. None
Selection Mode: Direct / Merit
Financial Assistance: Monthly scholarship of ₹700 (Day Scholars) / ₹1,100 (Hostellers) for Class 9-10 plus annual ad-hoc grant of ₹1,000. - Rs. 8000 per annum
Registration Requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
raw.faq_text:
Q: Who can apply for Pre-Matric Scholarship for Children of Parents Engaged in Unclean and Hazardous Occupations?
A: Eligible students studying in Class 1, Class 2, Class 3, Class 4, Class 5, Class 6, Class 7, Class 8, Class 9, Class 10.
Q: What is the official portal?
A: https://scholarships.gov.in
Q: Is OTR required for AY 2026-27?
A: Yes, One Time Registration is mandatory on National Scholarship Portal.

eligibility_summary.occupational_requirement: Children of parents engaged in manual scavenging, tanners, flayers, waste pickers, and hazardous cleaning as defined by MoSJE.
eligibility_summary.academic_requirement: Enrolled in a recognized institution in Classes 1 through 10.

benefits_summary.details: Monthly scholarship of ₹700 (Day Scholars) / ₹1,100 (Hostellers) for Class 9-10 plus annual ad-hoc grant of ₹1,000.

raw.inclusion_rationale: Affirmative action scheme guaranteeing secondary education support for children of marginalized sanitation and leather workers with no restrictive income cap.
